description: Search Zenodo's open research repository — datasets, software releases, publications, and other deposits — by keyword query plus filters for resource type, community, funder, grant, creator ORCID, file type, license, access status, and publication date. Returns one summary per deposit (ids, DOIs, title, type, version, creators, license, access, file totals, usage counts) plus facet counts over the full match set, every filter applied. Query terms are OR-ed unless joined with AND, quoted phrases match exactly, and field syntax works on record fields (metadata.title:"…", metadata.subjects.subject:"…"). Only the latest version of each deposit is searched unless all_versions is true, and only the first 10,000 matches are reachable by paging. Resolve community, funder, and grant names to ids with zenodo_lookup_vocabulary first; open one deposit in full with zenodo_get_record.

access_status.description: Access status: open, restricted, embargoed, or metadata-only. Case, spaces, hyphens, and underscores are ignored when matching (Metadata Only reads as metadata-only).

all_versions.description: Include superseded versions; by default only the latest version is searched.

award.description: One grant: an award id <funder-ror>::<number> (00k4n6c32::101135562), a bare grant number, or a CORDIS award DOI (10.3030/101135562). Find ids with zenodo_lookup_vocabulary (vocabulary: awards).

community.description: One community: its slug, UUID, or zenodo.org/communities/<slug> URL. Find slugs with zenodo_lookup_vocabulary (vocabulary: communities).

creator_orcid.description: Creator ORCID iD, e.g. 0000-0002-1825-0097; an https://orcid.org/ prefix is stripped and a trailing x uppercased.

file_type.description: File extensions, OR-ed (a single string is accepted): csv, zip, pdf, … Lowercased with any leading dot stripped.

funder.description: One funder: a ROR id (01cwqze88), a ROR URL, or a Crossref Funder DOI (10.13039/100000002). Resolve a funder name with zenodo_lookup_vocabulary (vocabulary: funders).

license.description: License id, e.g. cc-by-4.0, cc0-1.0, mit (lowercased). Find ids with zenodo_lookup_vocabulary (vocabulary: licenses).

page.description: Result page, starting at 1. page × size may not exceed 10,000.

published_from.description: Earliest publication date, YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD; a partial date starts at its first day.

published_to.description: Latest publication date, YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD; a partial date ends at its last day.

query.description: Keyword query. Terms are OR-ed unless joined with AND; "quoted phrases" match exactly; field syntax such as metadata.title:"…" or doi:"10.5281/zenodo.N" works. Escape a literal / as \/. A bare DOI or record URL is rejected; open it with zenodo_get_record instead. Omit to browse with filters only.

resource_type.description: Resource type ids, OR-ed (a single string is accepted): dataset, software, publication, publication-article, image-photo, … Any case; a subtype may also be written in the <type>::<id> form zenodo_lookup_vocabulary shows as its search value (publication::publication-article). A top-level type includes its subtypes. Look ids up with zenodo_lookup_vocabulary (vocabulary: resource_types).

sort.description: Sort order: bestmatch, newest, oldest, mostviewed, mostdownloaded, updated-desc, updated-asc. Case, spaces, hyphens, and underscores are ignored when matching (MostViewed reads as mostviewed). Defaults to bestmatch with a query, newest without.

name: zenodo_search_records

effectiveQuery.description: The exact q sent to Zenodo.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_is_identifier`: The query is a single DOI, doi.org URL, or zenodo.org record URL. `query_syntax`: The query has an unpaired unescaped / outside quotes. `query_failed`: Zenodo answered HTTP 500 for a query that passed the local checks. `upstream_timeout`: The search attempt got no complete response within its time budget. `unknown_community`: community resolves to no Zenodo community. `unknown_funder`: funder is not a known ROR id and no funder carries that Crossref Funder DOI. `invalid_date_range`: The expanded published_from is after published_to. `result_window_exceeded`: page × size exceeds 10,000. `rate_limited`: Zenodo answered HTTP 429, or this server's shared Zenodo request budget is spent for the current window. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Facet counts over the full match set (every filter applied, so they agree with total), not just this page.

id.description: Facet value id; feeds the matching zenodo_search_records filter.

file_type.description: Top 10 file types; ids feed file_type.

id.description: Facet value id; feeds the matching zenodo_search_records filter.

publication_year.description: The 10 most recent publication years present.

resource_type.description: Top 10 resource types; ids feed resource_type.

id.description: Facet value id; feeds the matching zenodo_search_records filter.

subtypes.description: Top 5 subtypes of this resource type.

id.description: Facet value id; feeds the matching zenodo_search_records filter.

subject.description: Top 10 subjects; query them as metadata.subjects.subject:"<label>".

has_more.description: True when another reachable page follows.

files.description: File access: public or restricted; absent when not reported.

status.description: open, restricted, embargoed, or metadata-only (unknown if Zenodo omits it).

communities.description: First 5 community slugs holding this record.

concept_doi.description: Concept DOI of the version series; absent for external DOIs.

concept_recid.description: Concept record id naming the whole version series; absent if Zenodo omits it.

description_snippet.description: First ~280 characters of the plain-text description; absent when the record has none.

doi.description: DOI of this version; absent on some old records.

downloads.description: Unique downloads across all versions; absent when Zenodo reports no usage counts.

file_count.description: Number of files; absent when files are restricted or embargoed.

is_latest.description: True when this is the newest version; absent if Zenodo omits version data.

license_ids.description: License ids (custom rights without an id are omitted; see zenodo_get_record).

publication_date.description: Publication date (EDTF as given: 2026-09-11, 2020, 2020-05); absent when not recorded.

recid.description: Record id of this version — pass to zenodo_get_record as id.

resource_type.description: Resource type; absent when not recorded.

id.description: Resource type id, e.g. dataset or publication-article.

title.description: Resource type label, when Zenodo supplies one.

total_bytes.description: Total file size in bytes; absent when files are restricted or embargoed.

version.description: Version label as deposited; absent when the depositor set none.

version_index.description: Position of this version in its series (1 = first); absent if Zenodo omits version data.

views.description: Unique views across all versions; absent when Zenodo reports no usage counts.

next_page.description: The next page number, when has_more.

notice.description: Guidance on empty results, the 10,000-result window, or further pages.

truncated.description: True when more reachable matches follow this page.

title: Search Zenodo records
